title: A note claiming a false namespace is filed in the real tenant
what: A tenant plants a note that names another tenant's namespace in the request. The server must ignore the claim and file the note under the caller's own tenant, so the note cannot reach into a tenant it does not belong to.

expect.desc: the targeted tenant never sees the planted note
no planted text reaches the targeted tenant
the note is filed under the writer's real tenant
the writer can still find its own note
